description: Miniature pose library (genericized). Includes bipedal_humanoid, quadrupedal, and facultatively_bipedal poses. Poses describe stance + hand actions + compatible prop geometry classes.

miniature_safe: At least one limb (foot/knee/hand) has clear contact with the base/terrain.
Base elements are low-profile unless explicitly needed for stability/readability.

hard_rules: No fused meshes - all parts must remain distinct volumes.
No zero-thickness parts - all elements must have printable wall thickness.
No coplanar overlaps - overlapping surfaces must have depth separation.
No unsupported floating elements - all parts must connect to the model or base.
No micro-detail below print threshold - minimum feature size must be printable (0.5mm+ equivalent).
soft_rules: Avoid limb and prop intersection where possible; clear air gaps preferred but not required.
Separation from body is preferred but not mandatory when expressive pose requires contact.
intentional_overlap: Crossed arms, braced weapons, forearm-to-forearm, and forearm-to-torso overlap are allowed when pose requires it.
Overlap must be deliberate, readable, and enhance pose attitude.
Maintain minimum printable clearance (2-4mm equivalent) between overlapping parts.
Overlapping forms must remain distinct volumes with readable edges; no merging or fusing.

wielded_objects: Separation from body preferred but not mandatory.
Controlled contact with forearm, shoulder, or chest allowed if pose intent requires it.
Hands must grip objects at clear, readable contact points.
Expressive pose takes priority over maximum separation.
3d_safe_pose_and_overlap.priority_statement: Expressive character pose and attitude take priority over full limb separation, provided HARD RULES remain satisfied.

pose_dominance: The body pose is primary and must not be altered to accommodate weapons.
Weapons must conform to the established arm, elbow, and shoulder positions.
Weapon orientation may adjust ONLY via wrist rotation or minor forearm adjustment.
No weapon may cause an arm to lift, extend, or change elevation beyond the defined pose.
If a conflict exists, the pose always overrides the weapon.

schema.name: string
schema.pose_style: static | ready | dynamic | victory | crouch | kneel

poses.name: Guarded Low Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent; torso angled 10â€“20 degrees; MAIN_HAND_PROP held low at the side of the body with clear negative space (not crossing torso); main hand grips MAIN_HAND_PROP; off hand open or lightly clenched for balance; elbows away from ribs; head turned toward threat; keep chest/face unobstructed.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle ground texture only.

poses.name: Over-Shoulder Carry (Relaxed Threat)
poses.pose_prompt: Asymmetric relaxed carry stance: weight clearly committed to the back leg (70–80%), front leg relaxed with slight bend; subtle contrapposto through hips and shoulders; torso leaned back slightly (2–5 degrees) to counterbalance the load. MAIN_HAND_PROP rests diagonally across the upper back and rear shoulder blade—not the neck—with the forward end extending past the shoulder but remaining below head height; prop must stay fully outside the head and neck silhouette with visible air gap. Main hand grips the MAIN_HAND_PROP at its natural grip point (handle/grip section for weapons, balanced point for tools)—NOT the barrel, blade, or head; arm bent naturally to support the weight. Off hand held slightly away from torso (side-out) for balance and micro-tension. Chest open, head forward or slightly turned; calm dominance posture with strong, readable silhouette.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional small low rock near rear foot for weight emphasis.

poses.name: Forward Lunge Action
poses.pose_prompt: Front foot planted firmly, back foot planted with heel lifted; hips drive forward; MAIN_HAND_PROP thrust forward in main hand, offset from torso; main hand actively grips MAIN_HAND_PROP; off hand pulled back for counterbalance; maintain strong negative space under arms and between prop and body; face/chest unobstructed.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a shallow broken-stone slab or rubble ridge under the lead foot.

poses.name: Unarmed Fighter Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Unarmed fighting stance: feet wide and planted; knees bent; fists up at chest/face level; elbows away from torso; torso slightly forward; shoulders squared; head turned toward opponent; preserve negative space between forearms and body.

poses.name: Triumph / Rally
poses.pose_prompt: Feet planted wide; chest lifted; main hand raised high overhead gripping MAIN_HAND_PROP firmly at its natural grip point (handle/grip section), held vertically or at a slight angle as a victory symbol; prop must be clearly above head height and read against the sky. Off hand clenched in fist or open gesture near chest/waist level; elbows away from body for strong silhouette. Triumphant, confident posture with the weapon displayed as a symbol of victory.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock under one foot for a heroic height boost.

poses.name: Two-Hand Aim (Wide Stance)
poses.pose_prompt: Feet planted shoulder-width; torso rotated toward target; both hands engaged on a two-hand object: main hand at control point, off hand supporting/bracing; elbows lifted slightly away from torso; keep the full object silhouette readable and offset from the chest.

poses.name: Two-Hand Kneel Aim
poses.pose_prompt: One knee down firmly, forward foot planted; hips low; both hands engaged on a two-hand object; keep forearms separated from torso; maintain clear negative space around the object; head aligned with aim line.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rubble mound supporting the kneeling contact.

poses.name: Two-Hand Dynamic Step Aim
poses.pose_prompt: Lead foot planted on raised terrain, trailing foot planted behind; torso twisted mid-aim; both hands engaged on a two-hand object; keep the object offset from the torso for a clean silhouette; cloth/gear may flow but must not cover hands or the object.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a medium-low rock ledge under the lead foot.

poses.name: Dual Spread Aim
poses.pose_prompt: Supported dynamic advance: lead foot planted on raised terrain, trail foot planted behind; torso twisted; main-hand prop oriented outward for visual display, off-hand prop oriented opposite, both not held in hands; arms wide with elbows away from ribs; props not crossing the torso; head aligned toward main-hand orientation. No hand contact with MAIN_HAND_PROP or OFF_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock shelf under the lead foot; low rubble only.

poses.name: Long + Short Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Forward charge with both feet grounded: lead foot planted, rear foot planted with heel raised; main-hand long prop pulled back in a striking arc; off-hand compact/guard prop held forward-low and out to the side; keep both props outside the torso silhouette; strong negative space under elbows.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a shallow ridge under the lead foot to emphasize momentum.

poses.name: Aim + Cover
poses.pose_prompt: Dynamic advance with asymmetric dual-wield: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot grounded behind; torso rotated slightly toward main-hand aim; MAIN_HAND_PROP (compact weapon/tool) aimed forward with arm extended but offset from torso centerline, not crossing chest silhouette; OFF_HAND_PROP (shield or defensive plane) held down and angled away from body, slightly to the side - NOT vertical in front of chest, NOT used as firing platform; clear negative space between weapon arm, shield, and torso; arms must not collapse into flat frontal plane; chest and face fully readable; head turned toward aim line; shield and weapon must not overlap torso.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low rock shelf under the lead foot; minimal debris only.

poses.name: CQB Forward
poses.pose_prompt: Close-quarters stance: feet planted wide; torso angled; main-hand compact prop visible forward and slightly offset as a symbolic element (not held in hands); off-hand compact prop visible low and out to the side (no hand contact); elbows away from ribs; strong negative space between forearms and body; forward lean; keep face/chest readable. No hand contact with MAIN_HAND_PROP or OFF_HAND_PROP; not gripped; not supported by hands.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional low curb/step near front toe for contact emphasis.

poses.name: Guardian Vigil
poses.pose_prompt: Protective vigil stance: feet planted wide and stable; weight centered; torso upright with calm presence; MAIN_HAND_PROP held low and angled outward from body (barrel/tip upward if long) in main hand; main hand grips MAIN_HAND_PROP; OFF_HAND_PROP replaced by an empty-hand warding/blessing gesture at chest/shoulder level; elbows away from ribs; strong vertical silhouette with clear negative space between arms and torso; head level with resolute gaze; avoid crossing items over the chest.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle ground texture only.

poses.name: Crossed Menace Stance
poses.pose_prompt: Standing straight with legs together; feet side by side. POSE CONSTRAINT (ABSOLUTE, OVERRIDES ALL): Both wrists are crossed tightly at throat level, forming a clear X-shape; this crossed-wrist pose is a hard skeletal constraint and may NOT be relaxed; main hand wrist crosses on top of off hand wrist; arms crossed against the chest, not extended. CROSS ORDER (ABSOLUTE): The main_hand arm must be the frontmost arm in screen space, visibly overlapping the off_hand arm at the wrist crossing; the off_hand arm must pass behind the main_hand forearm. HAND COUNT: exactly two arms and two hands total; no extra hands, partial hands, or duplicated limbs. GRIP CLUSTER (MANDATORY): Wrists are crossed tightly, but each hand maintains its own independent grip on its object; no two-handed firearm stance. WEAPONS: MAIN_HAND_PROP held in main hand pointing upward at steep angle (70-80 degrees from horizontal) next to one side of the head; OFF_HAND_PROP held in off hand at head level next to the other side of the head. HEAD: Head facing forward with eyes looking directly ahead between the two hands; strong menacing presence. SEPARATION: Weapons clearly separated from head and torso with visible air gaps; hands and weapons do not touch or obscure the face.

poses.name: Defensive Crouch
poses.pose_prompt: Low defensive crouch: feet wide with knees deeply bent, hips low; torso leaning forward; MAIN_HAND_PROP held diagonally across body at mid-height, angled outward for clear negative space; off hand extended low for balance or defensive gesture; weight on balls of feet; head forward with alert posture; prop kept away from torso silhouette.

poses.name: Sprint Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Dynamic sprint: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot pushing off; torso leaning forward with running momentum; MAIN_HAND_PROP carried horizontally at side or angled back, kept clear of torso; off hand pumping back for balance; head forward; strong diagonal silhouette suggesting forward motion.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Overhead Strike
poses.pose_prompt: Overhead strike: feet planted in forward stance; MAIN_HAND_PROP raised high overhead in striking arc, kept outside head silhouette; off hand extended low for balance; torso rotated toward strike; weight shifting forward; strong vertical reach with clear negative space.

poses.name: Charging Lasso Swing
poses.pose_prompt: Charging lasso swing: figure lunges forward in a running stride; lead foot planted, trail foot pushing off; torso pitched forward with rotational twist; MAIN_HAND_PROP raised high overhead by main hand, spinning in a wide arc kept clear of head silhouette; off hand grips the rope low at center body, anchoring and controlling the lasso; both hands actively grip the lasso rope; strong forward momentum with clear negative space around arms and rope loop.

poses.name: Side Guard Low
poses.pose_prompt: Side guard stance: feet shoulder-width; torso turned 45 degrees; MAIN_HAND_PROP held low at side with grip/stock at hip level, barrels angled sharply upward (approximately 35-45 degrees), with the muzzle clearly higher than the stock in screen space; strong upward foreshortening visible; entire prop from grip to tip clearly visible and separated from thigh and body; off hand raised in defensive position near chest; strong negative space between prop and torso; ready but patient posture.

poses.name: Two-Hand Low Sweep
poses.pose_prompt: Low sweeping strike: wide stance with knees bent; torso rotated; both hands engaged on two-hand object in horizontal sweeping arc at waist/hip level; prop kept clear of torso with strong negative space; head turned toward sweep direction; dynamic rotation.

poses.name: Two-Hand Overhead Chop
poses.pose_prompt: Overhead chop: lead foot forward on raised terrain; both hands gripping two-hand object raised high overhead in chopping arc; kept outside head silhouette; torso leaning forward; weight shifting onto lead foot; powerful downward strike posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Two-Hand March Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Marching carry: feet planted in walking stance; both hands holding two-hand object resting on shoulder or carried diagonally across back; casual march posture; object kept outside head/neck silhouette; calm confident stride.

poses.name: Two-Hand Defensive Brace
poses.pose_prompt: Defensive brace: wide stable stance; both hands gripping two-hand object held diagonally across body at chest/shoulder height; angled to deflect rather than block straight-on; torso turned slightly; defensive ready posture with clear negative space.

poses.name: Unarmed Aggressive Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Aggressive charge: lead foot planted on raised terrain, rear foot pushing; one fist/claw extended forward in striking position; other hand pulled back for power; torso leaning forward; head forward with aggressive expression; dynamic forward momentum.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Unarmed Defensive Crouch
poses.pose_prompt: Defensive crouch: feet wide with knees deeply bent, hips low; hands up in guarding positions - one forward, one to side; torso forward; weight on balls of feet; alert ready posture; strong negative space between arms and body.

poses.name: Unarmed Victory Roar
poses.pose_prompt: Victory roar: wide powerful stance with one foot on raised terrain; both arms raised high in triumphant gesture - fists clenched or claws spread; head thrown back in roaring expression; chest open; dominant victory posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under one foot.

poses.name: Dual Spinning Strike
poses.pose_prompt: Spinning strike: feet planted with torso rotated 90+ degrees suggesting spin motion; both compact props extended outward in opposite directions at torso height; arms wide with elbows away from body; strong horizontal silhouette; clear negative space between props, arms, and torso; dynamic rotation implied.

poses.name: Dual Crossed Defense
poses.pose_prompt: Crossed defensive stance: feet wide and stable; MAIN_HAND_PROP and OFF_HAND_PROP both raised and angled inward to create an X or crossed formation in front of body; held away from torso at mid-chest height with clear negative space; defensive posture; props must not merge into torso silhouette.

poses.name: Dual Asymmetric Ready
poses.pose_prompt: Asymmetric ready: feet shoulder-width; MAIN_HAND_PROP (compact) held forward in ready/aim position at shoulder height; OFF_HAND_PROP (long or compact) held low at side in relaxed carry; torso slightly turned; calm alert posture; both props kept clear of torso with negative space.

poses.name: Shield Bash Charge
poses.pose_prompt: Shield bash charge: lead foot planted on raised terrain; MAIN_HAND_PROP (shield) held forward in ramming position, angled slightly downward; off hand pulled back for momentum; torso leaning forward with charging posture; shield kept clear of face/head; aggressive forward drive.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with low rock under lead foot.

poses.name: Weapon Transition
poses.pose_prompt: Weapon transition: feet in ready stance; MAIN_HAND_PROP (long/compact) held low and angled away as if lowering or holstering; OFF_HAND_PROP (compact/small) raised forward in ready position; mid-transition posture between stances; both props visible with clear separation from torso.

poses.name: Low Stalking
poses.pose_prompt: Low stalking quadruped pose: body low to ground, all four legs visible and separated, spine arched slightly, head forward, predatory focus; clear definition between legs and torso; weight distributed evenly.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with subtle ground texture.

poses.name: Charging Run
poses.pose_prompt: Charging quadruped: powerful forward momentum, extended front leg reaching, rear legs driving, spine stretched in running gait; all legs clearly visible and separated; dynamic forward lean.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with motion implied.

poses.name: Howling
poses.pose_prompt: Howling quadruped: head thrown back, muzzle pointed upward, chest expanded, all four legs planted firmly; body stable and grounded; clear separation between legs.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface, slight elevation implied by posture only.

poses.name: Seated Watch
poses.pose_prompt: Seated watch quadruped: rear haunches seated, front legs straight and upright, head alert and forward-facing; dignified sentinel posture; all legs clearly visible.

poses.name: Circling
poses.pose_prompt: Circling quadruped: body angled in circular motion, legs positioned for turning gait, head turned to track prey; all four legs visible; weight shifting into turn.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; flat surface with implied circular motion.

poses.name: Long Distance Lope
poses.pose_prompt: Endurance lope quadruped: efficient running gait, elongated stride, legs extended in loping rhythm; relaxed but relentless posture; all legs clearly defined.

poses.name: Overhead Display
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal overhead display: standing upright on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP raised overhead as dramatic element, angled away from body for clear negative space; chest and torso fully exposed; arms raised for dramatic composition; both shoulders/arms/chest/face visible.

poses.name: Full Howl
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal howling: head thrown back in supernatural howl, MAIN_HAND_PROP extended outward showing full torso, off-hand visible; ecstatic commanding howl pose with both arms clearly visible and separated from body.

poses.name: Low Sweeping Pose
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal low sweep: low stance on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP extended away from torso in sweeping arc at low height; strong silhouette with weapon distinct from body.

poses.name: Menacing Advance
poses.pose_prompt: Bipedal menacing advance: forward stepping stance on digitigrade legs, MAIN_HAND_PROP positioned forward and away from body; threatening forward lean; upright stance with full torso visible.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; rock step with forward momentum.

poses.name: Hands-in-Belt Lean
poses.pose_prompt: Casual town idle: weight 70–80% on the back leg; front foot relaxed and slightly forward; thumbs hooked into belt/suspenders area (hands close-in); shoulders slightly rounded; head turned 10–20 degrees as if watching street activity. Keep elbows slightly away from ribs to preserve small negative space; no heroic chest-out posture.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle dirt/boardwalk texture only.

poses.name: Hat Tip Acknowledgment
poses.pose_prompt: Frontier greeting: feet planted comfortably; one hand raised close-in touching hat brim (or forehead line if no hat), elbow bent; subtle head nod; off hand relaxed slightly side-out. Avoid large arm spread; keep gesture readable but compact for crowd use.

poses.name: Arms Folded, Foot Tapped
poses.pose_prompt: Waiting posture: arms folded loosely at mid-chest (not tight/hostile), forearms separated slightly from torso; one heel lifted or toe angled outward to suggest foot-tap impatience. Keep silhouette compact and repeatable; avoid props crossing face/chest.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle ground texture only.

poses.name: One-Hand Talker
poses.pose_prompt: Conversation gesture: torso turned 10–20 degrees toward an implied listener; one hand mid-gesture side-out (palm half-open), elbow away from ribs for a clean silhouette; other hand close-in near waistline. Keep motion small and natural—no grand speeches.

poses.name: Listener with Head Tilt
poses.pose_prompt: Passive listener: slight lean toward implied speaker; hands clasped close-in at waist or behind back (choose one when sculpting); head tilted 10–15 degrees. Keep elbows from merging into torso; preserve small negative space where possible.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; subtle dirt or boardwalk texture.

poses.name: Slow Street Walk
poses.pose_prompt: Natural walk cycle mid-stride: lead foot planted flat; trail foot stepping through; arms swing slightly down-away (small arc), hands relaxed. Keep gait calm (not sprint). Ensure both legs are clearly separated for print-readability.

poses.name: Turn-and-Look Over Shoulder
poses.pose_prompt: Subtle reaction: hips mostly forward, torso rotated 20–30 degrees, head turned farther over shoulder as if hearing a call; arms close-in and relaxed (optionally one hand holding coat/lapel). Keep pose compact and repeatable; no dramatic twist.

poses.name: Crate Brace & Rest
poses.pose_prompt: Labor pause: one foot planted on a low crate/ledge; forearm braced on raised knee (close-in); other arm relaxed near hip. Keep elbow and forearm separated from torso so it reads cleanly; avoid thin unsupported spans by keeping brace contact obvious.
poses.base_prompt: Round base with a low crate/step at the front quadrant (low-profile, stable).

poses.name: Broom / Tool Idle Hold
poses.pose_prompt: Frontier chore stance: MAIN_HAND_PROP held as a broom/rake/long tool angled down-away with the bottom near the ground but not fused into base; hand at mid-shaft; off hand close-in near waist. Keep tool clearly separated from legs with visible air gap; avoid crossing torso silhouette.

poses.name: Standing Newspaper Read
poses.pose_prompt: Newspaper reader: feet planted; elbows slightly out; both hands holding an implied folded paper forward-offset at mid-chest height (not covering face); keep paper plane angled so it reads in silhouette and does not merge into torso. Preserve negative space under elbows.

poses.name: Saloon Drink / Toast
poses.pose_prompt: Saloon casual toast: MAIN_HAND_PROP (cup/mug/bottle) raised forward-offset at chest height; elbow slightly away from torso so the prop reads clearly; off hand close-in at waist or resting on belt. Keep face unobstructed; avoid over-extended arm.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional faint plank texture.

poses.name: Water Bucket Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Practical carry: MAIN_HAND_PROP (bucket) held down-away beside the leg with a clear air gap from thigh; slight torso counter-lean to balance weight; off hand side-out for balance. Keep bucket silhouette readable and not fused into base; avoid thin handle-only support by implying hand-to-bucket contact at grip.

poses.name: Lady with Sun Umbrella
poses.pose_prompt: Victorian/frontier lady stroll: upright posture; MAIN_HAND_PROP (sun umbrella/parasol) held forward-offset with canopy above shoulder line but not covering the face; elbow slightly away from torso so the shaft reads cleanly. Off hand close-in lightly gathering skirt or holding a small accessory. Keep umbrella separate from head silhouette (visible air gap) and avoid ultra-thin shaft spans—prefer a slightly thicker, print-safe shaft.

poses.name: Whittling (Standing)
poses.pose_prompt: Casual whittling: hands close-in at mid-torso holding small tool + small wood piece; elbows slightly out for readability; head angled down as if watching hands. Keep both props outside the torso silhouette enough to read; avoid knife crossing the body plane.

poses.name: Fiddle Player
poses.pose_prompt: Fiddle stance: OFF_HAND_PROP held close-in under chin/shoulder line (instrument), MAIN_HAND_PROP side-out as bow hand with elbow slightly away from ribs; torso upright with small sway. Keep instrument from fully covering face; preserve negative space between bow arm and torso for print clarity.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional faint plank texture.

poses.name: Shopkeeper / Vendor Gesture
poses.pose_prompt: Vendor mid-sale: one hand forward-offset in a presenting gesture (palm up, small arc), other hand close-in as if holding apron edge, ledger, or coins. Torso slightly leaned forward in friendly engagement; keep gesture compact and repeatable for crowd use.

poses.name: Lasso Overhead Swing (Charge)
poses.pose_prompt: Dynamic leaping charge: lead foot just planted or pushing off with explosive force, trail leg extended behind with foot lifting off ground showing forward leap motion; body pitched forward with aggressive momentum. Main hand extended high overhead at full reach gripping MAIN_HAND_PROP (lasso/rope) at the throwing point, arm straight and committed to the throw with lasso loop visible overhead in wide arc. Off hand grips the rope lower down near torso (close-in), bracing and controlling the coils or slack—creating clear hand separation and distinct roles (thrower vs holder). Torso twisted with throwing motion; shoulders engaged showing power transfer from body to throw. Face intense and locked on target ahead; whole body expressing explosive forward leap into action. Lasso loop must be clearly visible overhead with both the thrown loop and the held coils/rope visible, creating strong dynamic silhouette. Clear air gap between rope elements and body/head.
poses.base_prompt: Round base; optional small rock or ground texture under lead foot to emphasize leap and push-off.

poses.name: Churchgoer Hymnbook Hold
poses.pose_prompt: Churchgoer standing in calm reverence: feet planted shoulder-width; elbows slightly away from ribs to preserve air gaps. Both hands hold a thick hymnbook/prayer book at upper chest height, book rotated 30–45° outward so it clearly breaks the camera plane. Keep the book fully separated from torso with a visible gap; hands touch only at clear grip points on the book edges; head slightly bowed or forward-facing; composed, respectful posture.

poses.name: Church Prayer (Hands Clasped)
poses.pose_prompt: Quiet prayer stance: feet together or slightly apart; shoulders relaxed; hands clasped at mid-chest but held 2–3 cm forward from torso to keep negative space; elbows out slightly for a clean silhouette; head gently bowed. No props.

poses.name: Churchgoer Hat-in-Hand
poses.pose_prompt: Respectful standing pose: one hand holds a thick-brim hat down at the side, hat rotated outward 30–45° to break the camera plane and keep an air gap from thigh/hip. Off-hand relaxed near beltline, not touching torso. Upright posture, calm expression.

poses.name: Rich Townsman Cane Stroll
poses.pose_prompt: Affluent strolling gait: lead foot stepping forward, trail foot grounded behind. Main hand carries a thick cane angled forward and outward (30–45°) so it clearly breaks the camera plane; keep cane tip away from base edge and maintain a clean air gap from legs. Off-hand relaxed near waist. Upright chest and confident carriage.

poses.name: Rich Lady Hand Fan
poses.pose_prompt: Elegant standing pose: weight slightly on back foot; main hand holds a thick folding fan at upper chest height, fan rotated outward with a clear gap from torso (no contact). Elbow away from ribs to preserve negative space. Off-hand near hip or lightly curled, not touching body. Small composed head tilt.

poses.name: Poor Beggar Bowl Hold
poses.pose_prompt: Humbled street pose: shoulders slightly rounded but full silhouette clear. Main hand extends forward holding a thick bowl/cup, wrist rotated so the bowl faces slightly upward and outward; keep an air gap between arm and torso; elbow away from ribs. Off-hand rests near abdomen but held slightly forward from body. Head slightly lowered.

poses.name: Butcher Cleaver Rest
poses.pose_prompt: Working stance: feet planted, torso upright. Main hand holds a thick cleaver down and outward beside the leg, blade angled 30–45° away from body with visible foreshortening and a clear air gap from thigh/hip. Off-hand open, small explanatory gesture near chest but offset forward from torso. Neutral, focused expression.

poses.name: Baker Loaf Offer
poses.pose_prompt: Vendor offer pose: main hand extends forward holding a thick bread loaf (or wrapped parcel) angled outward; keep loaf fully separated from torso with visible air gap; elbow lifted away from ribs. Off-hand rests near waistline. Friendly posture with slight forward lean.

poses.name: Carpenter Saw Shoulder Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Work carry: main hand grips a thick hand saw resting diagonally near shoulder, with the blade plane rotated outward so it does NOT overlap head/neck silhouette; maintain clear air gaps from torso. Off-hand slightly out for balance. Stance grounded and practical.

poses.name: Miner Pickaxe Rest
poses.pose_prompt: Sturdy rest pose: both hands hold a thick pickaxe shaft diagonally across the front, kept forward-offset so it does not touch the torso; pick head angled outward 30–45° to break camera plane; elbows away from ribs for negative space. Calm, tired posture.

poses.name: Doctor Bag Check
poses.pose_prompt: Professional pause: main hand holds a thick medical bag by handle at side, bag rotated outward with air gap from thigh. Off-hand raised slightly, palm inward as if thinking/checking a note (no paper required). Upright attentive posture.

poses.name: Gambler Card Shuffle
poses.pose_prompt: Saloon-ready stance: both hands held forward-offset at mid-chest manipulating a thick deck of cards (cards as a single solid block for 3D safety). Keep the deck and hands clearly separated from torso with visible air gaps; elbows out to maintain negative space. Subtle confident lean.

poses.name: Posting Notice (Hammer)
poses.pose_prompt: Town notice pose: off-hand holds a thick placard/paper board forward and outward (as a single rigid slab), not touching torso. Main hand raises a thick hammer to the side of the head (kept outside head silhouette), angled outward to break the camera plane. Arms separated from body with clear air gaps; stable stance.

poses.name: Handshake Offer
poses.pose_prompt: Greeting stance: main hand extended forward at mid height as an offered handshake, palm vertical, arm offset from torso centerline with visible air gap. Off-hand relaxed near beltline. Friendly neutral posture; compact and repeatable for crowds.

poses.name: Kid Marble Game Crouch
poses.pose_prompt: Child crouch: deep squat with heels grounded; torso leaned forward but clear silhouette. Main hand reaches toward ground in front (marbles implied; no tiny props), fingers together as a simplified scoop. Off-hand out to the side for balance. Keep arms separated from torso with air gaps.

poses.name: Kid Holding Treat
poses.pose_prompt: Child idle: upright stance with small steps implied. Main hand holds a thick treat/candy stick at chest height, rotated outward and kept away from torso. Off-hand relaxed. Head turned slightly as if watching something interesting.

poses.name: Market Basket Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Shopping walk: lead foot stepping, trail foot planted behind. Main hand carries a thick market basket down at side, basket rotated outward with air gap from leg. Off arm swings slightly outward (kept off torso) for a clean silhouette.

poses.name: Two-Hand Gossip Talk
poses.pose_prompt: Animated but compact gossip: both hands raised at mid-chest, palms slightly up, held forward-offset from torso with elbows away from ribs to preserve negative space. Torso leaned forward 5–10° as if confiding. No props.

poses.name: Church Procession Walk
poses.pose_prompt: Measured walk suitable for church crowd: small forward step with upright spine; arms held closer than a normal walk but still offset from torso with slight bend at elbows to keep air gaps. Calm forward gaze.

poses.name: Restrained Disagreement
poses.pose_prompt: Restrained disagreement: feet planted; both hands raised slightly at mid-chest level with palms forward in a 'hold on' or 'wait' gesture; elbows away from ribs; torso upright but slightly tense; expression shows frustration but controlled. Keep gestures compact and readable; avoid wild arm movements.

poses.name: Watchful Stand
poses.pose_prompt: Watchful standing posture: feet planted shoulder-width; hands relaxed at sides or one hand resting near belt; torso upright; head slightly turned as if scanning surroundings; alert but calm demeanor. Keep silhouette simple and readable.

poses.name: Child Looking Up
poses.pose_prompt: Child looking upward: feet together or slightly apart; hands relaxed at sides; head tilted back 20-30 degrees; attentive expression as if watching or listening to an adult. Keep silhouette compact.

poses.name: Child Fidgeting
poses.pose_prompt: Child fidgeting: weight shifted to one leg; one hand fiddling with clothing or scratching; other hand at side; slight twist in torso; restless but grounded posture.

poses.name: Adjusting Shawl
poses.pose_prompt: Adjusting shawl: feet planted; one or both hands raised to shoulder/neck area as if pulling or adjusting a shawl; keep hands close to body; head slightly tilted.

poses.name: Bundle Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Two-handed bundle carry: both arms supporting a thick wrapped bundle at mid-chest height; elbows slightly out for clearance; feet planted; upright posture.

poses.name: Idle Sway
poses.pose_prompt: Off-balance idle sway: feet wider apart than normal; weight shifted to one side; slight lean in torso; one hand near body for balance; relaxed but unsteady posture suggesting intoxication or fatigue.

poses.name: Child Hands In Pockets
poses.pose_prompt: Child with hands in pockets: feet slightly apart; both hands tucked into trouser or jacket pockets at hip level; shoulders slightly forward; closed-off posture; head neutral or slightly down.

poses.name: Wall Lean
poses.pose_prompt: Casual wall lean: weight on one foot; other foot crossed or resting; shoulder tilted as if leaning against an implied surface; arms relaxed or crossed loosely; casual observant demeanor.

poses.name: Pointing Gesture
poses.pose_prompt: Pointing gesture: one arm extended side-out with index finger pointing; elbow slightly bent; other hand relaxed near body; torso turned toward pointing direction; clear directional indication.

poses.name: Holding Child At Side
poses.pose_prompt: Holding child at side: one arm supporting a small bundled form (implied child) at hip level; other arm free at side; weight balanced; protective posture; careful stance.

poses.name: Idle Wall Lean
poses.pose_prompt: Idle lean with awareness: shoulder angled as if leaning on wall; arms loosely crossed or one hand near belt; feet planted with slight hip shift; alert expression; casual but watchful.

poses.name: Tool Idle Stand
poses.pose_prompt: Tool idle: one hand holding a long tool (broom, rake, shovel) vertically at side; tool butt near ground; other hand relaxed near body; upright resting stance.

poses.name: Crate Lean Rest
poses.pose_prompt: Crate rest: one foot propped on implied low surface; elbow or hand resting on raised knee; relaxed tired posture; other hand near body; taking a break stance.

poses.name: Slow Walk
poses.pose_prompt: Slow measured walk: small stride mid-step; lead foot forward, trail foot planted; arms hanging naturally with minimal swing; deliberate careful gait; upright posture.

poses.name: Heavy Bucket Carry
poses.pose_prompt: Two-handed bucket carry: both hands gripping bucket handle at chest or hip height; arms slightly away from body with weight evident; elbows out for clearance; strain visible in posture; feet planted wide.

poses.name: Idle Arms Folded
poses.pose_prompt: Reserved arms folded: forearms crossed at mid-chest with small air gaps from torso; feet together or slightly apart; upright closed posture; neutral or disapproving expression.

poses.name: Vendor Presentation
poses.pose_prompt: Vendor presentation: one or both hands extended forward with palms up in presenting gesture; welcoming posture; slight lean forward; friendly expression; showcasing implied goods.

poses.name: Hands In Pockets
poses.pose_prompt: Casual hands in pockets: both hands tucked into trouser or jacket pockets at hip level; shoulders relaxed; weight on one leg or evenly distributed; casual closed-off posture.
